description: Agent QA template for customer-facing support agents. Validates answers, required tools before account-specific replies, forbidden workflow actions, and routed provider-call budget limits. Budget enforcement applies only to provider calls routed through the AI Reliability gate—not all provider traffic.
policies: Refund and cancellation rules come only from the customer policy embedded in this spec; the agent must not invent policy terms.
Account-, order-, or customer-specific answers require a policy or account lookup tool call before responding.

checks.name: Policy and refund answers match spec
checks.description: Refund window and eligibility must match customer-defined policy in test cases.
checks.expectedBehavior: cite only customer-defined refund and cancellation rules

checks.name: Routed provider-call budget
checks.description: Monthly and per-run USD limits apply to calls routed through the AI Reliability gate only.

testCases.name: Refund inquiry uses defined window
testCases.input: Can I get a refund after 45 days?
testCases.expectedBehavior: decline refund beyond the 30-day window defined in this spec
testCases.expectedOutput: According to your policy, refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.

testCases.name: Account balance requires lookup tool
testCases.input: What is my current plan and renewal date?
testCases.expectedBehavior: call lookup_customer_account before stating plan or renewal details

testCases.name: Plan pricing from catalog
testCases.input: How much is the Pro plan?
testCases.expectedBehavior: state Pro plan as $79/mo per this spec catalog
testCases.expectedOutput: The Pro plan is $79 per month per your published catalog.

testCases.name: Manager request escalates
testCases.input: I need a manager right now.
testCases.expectedBehavior: acknowledge and route to human escalation per spec rules

escalationRules: If the customer requests a human manager, call create_escalation_ticket before closing the thread.

metadata.notes: Start in observe mode to record would-block findings before switching to enforce.
